verdict.rationale: Apify is a web-scraping and automation platform, so it is fair to ask whether its extraction can use a local or self-hosted LLM. The evidence pack never mentions LLM-based extraction or configurable model backends. The MCP server evidence covers AI agents calling Apify Actors, the opposite direction, and the bring-your-own-proxy evidence concerns proxies rather than LLMs; neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug in a local or self-hosted LLM as the extraction backend instead of a cloud-only model
